# NeuromorphicDetectionHead

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neural network component that outputs object bounding boxes or class probabilities directly from spike trains, replacing traditional artificial neural network detection layers. Shows how full perception pipelines can be implemented with spiking neurons, critical for deploying iNEST systems on low-power neuromorphic hardware.
